general.description: Orca is the ADE for working with a fleet of parallel agents. Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.
general.description_zh: Orca 是用于操作并行 agent 集群的 ADE。用你自己的订阅运行任意 coding agent。支持桌面端、移动端和远程 runtime。

general.name: anthropics/claude-code
general.description: Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that lives in your terminal, understands your codebase, and helps you code faster by executing routine tasks, explaining complex code, and handling git workflows - all through natural language commands.
general.description_zh: Claude Code 是一款驻留在终端中的智能编码工具，能够理解你的代码库，通过自然语言命令执行日常任务、解释复杂代码、处理 git 工作流，帮助你更快地编写代码。

general.name: affaan-m/ECC
general.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
general.description_zh: 智能体框架性能优化系统。为 Claude Code、Codex、Opencode、Cursor 等提供技能、直觉、记忆、安全性及研究优先的开发能力。

general.name: rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch
general.description: Learn it. Build it. Ship it for others.
general.description_zh: 学会它。构建它。分享给他人。

general.name: alibaba/open-code-review
general.description: Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.
general.description_zh: 安全、快速、高效，经阿里巴巴大规模实战检验。混合架构代码审查工具：确定性 pipeline + LLM Agent，精确到行级注释，内置多语言规则集（NPE、线程安全、XSS、SQL 注入），兼容 OpenAI 与 Anthropic。

general.name: cloudflare/quiche

general.description_zh: 🥧 QUIC 传输协议与 HTTP/3 的精致实现
